summary: Starco Brands filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, reporting that the Company and its subsidiary borrowers amended their existing loan agreement with Pasadena Private Lending Inc. effective September 29, 2026, cutting the Applicable Margin from 5.50% to 4.25% per annum through maturity. No special-situation event, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is involved. The disclosures are incorporated from the July 2026 credit agreement and are a routine financing modification. Watch for margin relief impact on interest expense, covenant compliance, and any further amendments or defaults.
